==Transportation==
The blast mine is located in the northern section of [[Lovakengj]] and may be accessed via a number of ways:

# Run north from the Xeric's Inferno option on the [[Xeric's talisman]].
# Run north from the [[jewellery of jubilation]] teleport on the [[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[book of the dead]].
# Run north from Lovakengj station on the [[Lovakengj Minecart Network]].
